statements.status_notes: CVE-2020-8203 is prototype pollution via attacker-controlled path arguments to lodash.set; no fixed release of the standalone lodash.set package exists. It is vendored solely by @octokit/rest@16, which invokes it with its own hard-coded endpoint route strings as paths, never request- or response-derived values, in browser-executed git-import flows. The bridge server does not run this code.
